name: lascoria
description: Understand, steer, and review parallel coding work from one live map of tasks, dependencies, changes, and evidence.

scripts.test: npm run build && cargo test --manifest-path supervisor/Cargo.toml && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.js
scripts.check: cargo fmt --manifest-path runtime-support/Cargo.toml --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path supervisor/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path runtime-support/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path supervisor/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && prettier --check src testing test scripts package.json .prettierrc.json && prettier --check ui vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json src-tauri/*.json src-tauri/capabilities/*.json
scripts.format: cargo fmt --manifest-path runtime-support/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path supervisor/Cargo.toml && prettier --write src testing test scripts package.json .prettierrc.json ui vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json src-tauri/*.json src-tauri/capabilities/*.json
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && playwright test
scripts.check:ui: tsc && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
